quarterly_data.signal: First half of the year ending March 2026 (April-September 2025, semi-annual report): net sales JPY 195,485 million (+7.7% year on year), operating income JPY 32,573 million (+14.2%), ordinary income JPY 32,305 million (+9.4%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 22,069 million (+7.5%). Electronics: net sales JPY 113,547 million (+15.6%), segment profit JPY 25,429 million (+41.4%) - management states orders for generative-AI server substrates stayed strong, demand for high-performance IC package substrates for PCs and general-purpose servers recovered moderately though without strength, and cost-reduction activities at the Philippines plant helped. Ceramics: net sales JPY 39,689 million (-8.0%), segment profit JPY 3,839 million (-45.8%) - DPF and AFP volumes fell on slowing demand, special carbon (FGM) sales fell on weak power-semiconductor demand hit by the EV slowdown and some customers' inventory adjustment, and EV battery safety parts (NEV, moved into the Ceramics business from this year) grew sales on the start of mass production but profit fell on higher fixed costs as the EV market slowed more than expected. Other: net sales JPY 42,248 million (+5.1%), segment profit JPY 3,250 million (-6.8%). Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 15,958 million.
